script.problem: It has 21 words. Each line is 20 words or fewer.
"Gentiles" and "peoples" aren't the same kind of thing (one is a name, one isn't).

terra.problem: The line implies that the child will lead the wolf and lamb. The verse does not explicitly say that; it mentions the calf, young lion, and fatling immediately before saying the child will lead them.
The verse calls on people to make His works known; it does not say they will do so.
